name: track-archive-repo-map-drift
title: Prevent archive repository-map drift
description: Ensure generated repository maps are refreshed or validated after Trellis task archive moves so PRs do not retain stale active-task paths.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Created from item 6 in the cross-session Trellis review. Downstream CI failed after Trellis task archive moves left generated repository maps with stale active-task paths. Treat implementation ownership as mixed until the map generator, lifecycle wrapper, and consumer generated-doc policy are confirmed.
